book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Debele tu wu mone Jiso
Kiyo ki Yuude mo ki ja ki jo Jiso ki gɛɛŋ bɛ wu kwa lɛ debele moŋ wu.
Wu gɛɛŋ wù nyu yo wu shee wu too wu chee, wu jii gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ, yi aju le mbaanyɛ. Ajiŋ ayu jɛŋ ja yi yuu wu.
Wu wɛɛ wù mone bamii mo wu to wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo nɛ le Mwa Nyo, wo dû ata kanɛ tu bantu ba blɛd.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,
‘Gɛ muh chee gɛh nje mwɛɛ munjile maa gɛ.
Muh chee tɛ nje jɛ yichii yì bude jwe wù Nyo le.’”

content: Noo, Sataŋ mo wu jo wu, wu gɛɛŋ bɛ wu a kinlaantɛŋ kì Yɛlusalɛm le, wu leesɛ wu fɛ kigo ki yeh yi kintanyɛ le,
wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo nɛ le Mwa Nyo, wo selɛ fɛkuu, nje fi le ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Nyo lé wu dû banchɛndaa be le lɛ bo chîɛɛŋ wo.’

content: Fi ka nyu ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Bo lé bo gê bo kaŋ lo wo,
lɛ keefɛ wo kfuuŋ kikaa yi tɛdɛ le gɛ.’”

content: Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ

content.text: “Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,
‘Keefɛ wo mône Tada wù Nyo wo gɛ.’”

content: Debele ka wu jo Jiso fo, wu gɛɛŋ nyu yi kikwɛɛ ki mbegɛ wumu wu ndefe fɛwe wesee le, wu mo wu chunyɛ bituŋ bi yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le bichii bɛ bvukugɛ bvuyu bvuchii.
No wu chunyi noo wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Nlé nnyâ mwɛɛ munɛ munchii wo le, fɛ wo nɛ le wo gwe a mɛ jii wo ŋgvuuŋ mɛ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛnɛ yaga Sataŋ! Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,
‘Wo ŋgvûune Tada wù Nyo wo,
wo lɛ̂ne nyu wu le maa.’”

content: Noo debele mo wu chinɛ Jiso le, wu gɛɛŋ. Fi kooshɛ lɛ banchɛndaa ba Nyo gɛ̀ ja bo to bo jiiŋe fɛ wu le.
Jiso kɛ lɛme che Galalee
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu yu lɛ ba le ba koo Joŋ Nlesɛajoo ba leesɛ wu yeh yi ncha le, wu mo wu ja wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ kimbe kì Galalee le.
Wu gɛɛŋ wu bu Nasalɛ, wu ja yo wu gɛɛŋ wu tu wu chee a kilaantɛŋ kì Kafanahum le. Kilaantɛŋ kinɛ gɛ̀ bee mbebe Mamasi wù Galalee le mo mbebe bimbe bi bamii ba Sɛbuluŋ bɛ ba Naftali le.
Finɛ fiɛɛ gɛ̀ kooshi nɛ lɛ fi kojɛ no muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Yosaya gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa lɛ,

content.text: “Kimbe kì Sɛbuluŋ bɛ kì Naftali,
bì le mbebe mamasi le Joo yì Jodaŋ le wuŋ kwege,
nshɛŋ yi Galalee yì bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ,
bamii ba chi shee bo chee kijibɛ le,
le bo yɛŋ wa n'yuu wù baaŋ le.
Juu le chi saaŋ wa fɛ bamii banɛ,
ba chi shee bo chee gwɛŋ wu kijibɛ ki kwe le.”

content: Kɛge kife kɛɛ le, Jiso mo wu kɛ wu feeji bamii le wu jɛme lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kûsɛ muntele mwɛna, nje bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le wa mbebe le!”

content: Jiso tɛɛŋ bamii banɛh lɛ bo nyû booŋ be ba ŋgoo

Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu jiɛnyi mbebe Mamasi wù Galalee le, wu yɛŋ bamii bamu le bafɛɛ, nyu muh bɛ mwa bwee. Bamii banɛ gɛ̀ bee Samoŋ wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Bita, bɛ mwa bwee wù Andulu, bo nooŋ gii a mamasi le, no lɛme chiboo gɛ̀ bee bíɛŋ yi kolɛ.
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bîi mɛne nlé nfɛ̂ bɛŋ bɛŋ koode wa nyume bamii!”

content: Kimimia bo mo bo chinɛ gii yiboo le bo bii wu le.

Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu ja fo wu kɛŋsɛ, wu ka wu yɛŋ bamii bamu le bafɛɛ nyu gɛh muh bɛ mwa bwee. Bamii banɛ gɛ̀ bee Jɛm bɛ mwa bwee wù Joŋ ba gɛ̀ bee booŋ ba Jɛbɛdi, bo nyu a ŋguh le bɛ chiji bo wù Jɛbɛdi bo chvuushi gii. Wu tɛɛŋ tɛ bo.
Kimimia bo mo bo chinɛ ŋguh le bɛ chiji bo, bo bii wu le.
Jiso tu wu yɛyi bamii wu ka fɛde ba binchɛŋ
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu jiɛnyi kimbe kì Galalee le kichii wu yɛyi bamii yéh yi buunɛ yiboo le wu feeji tɛ saaka wù joŋe kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo. Wu ka fɛde binchɛŋ bichii mo goŋ yichii yi bamii le.

Noo, saaka kune wu saaŋe wu gɛɛŋ woŋ wù Silia le wuchii. Bamii mo bo too bɛ bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ chɛne mo ba gɛ̀ bee yi manluŋ le fɛ wu le, kɛnɛ le ba banchɛndaa ba debele njiŋse bɛ bo, kɛnɛ bo gwee kika, kɛnɛ ba kwe wa kimbe kimimia. Bo too bɛ bo noo wu fɛde bo bachii.

Mo faaŋ fɛ wu gɛ̀ gɛɛne fo binchvu bi bamii bì baaŋ bi kfuune bi bii a wu jiŋ. Bamii banɛ gɛ̀ jade kimbe ki woŋ kì Galalee le, bamu jade a Bilaantɛŋ bi Yuufe le, bamu Yɛlusalɛm mo bantɛ ba Judia ba bamu le. Bamu jade a Joo yì Jodaŋ le wuŋ kwege.
